ValidationRule.description: Requires Business Case Justification, Desired Future State, Internal Approvals Received, Solution Approach Validated, Success Criteria, and Technical Validation Completed to be populated leaving Stage 2, and to remain populated through every later stage a
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cross-Sell/Upsell") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "High Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Medium Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Low Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "No Touch") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "RIM"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "ALM") ),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solutioning"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup") ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed") ),
OR( NOT(Business_Case_Justification__c), ISBLANK(Desired_Future_State__c), AND( Amount > 25000, NOT(Internal_Approvals_Received__c) ), NOT(Solution_Approach_Validated__c), ISBLANK(Success_Criteria__c), NOT(Technical_Validation_Completed__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete Business Case Justification, Desired Future State, Internal Approvals Received, Solution Approach Validated, Success Criteria, and Technical Validation Completed before leaving Stage 2. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Par
